entry.name: jit.p.bounds
entry.digest: Limit particles to a region of space
entry.description: The jit.p.bounds object creates limits in a particle system. Limits may be applied to any of the qualities of the system (with the exception of the reserved life and ID qualities).

attributes.description: The upper limit value, per plane, starting at plane 2 (planes 0 and 1 are reserved) (default = 1.)A symbol may be used to indicate that the bound is disabled.
